banner.title: We value your privacy
banner.text: We use cookies and similar technologies. Necessary cookies keep the site working. With your permission we also use optional cookies for features, analytics and marketing. You can accept all, reject all, or choose per category, and change your mind at any time.

preferences.title: Cookie preferences
preferences.text: Choose which optional categories you allow. Necessary cookies cannot be switched off because the site does not work without them.

necessary.title: Necessary
necessary.description: Required for basic functions such as security, load balancing and remembering this consent choice.

functional.title: Functional
functional.description: Remember preferences such as language or region and enable embedded features.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Help us understand how the site is used so we can improve it.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: Used to measure and personalise advertising across websites.

blockedContent: This content is blocked until you allow the "{category}" category.
